question: Which HS2 product chapters had the largest decline in Luxembourg's exports from 2022 to 2023 energy crisis?

limitations.message: Values are in current euros (nominal), not adjusted for price changes.
2.1 % of this value is confidential at full product detail (masked codes); it is shown as a separate 'Confidential' slice, never dropped.

sql:
SELECT
  year,
  hs2 AS key,
  flow,
  SUM(value_eur) AS value_eur,
  SUM(qty_kg) AS qty_kg
FROM v_lu_trade_hs2
WHERE
  period >= CAST('2022-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND period < CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND flow = 'export'
  AND year IN (2022, 2023)
GROUP BY
  year,
  key,
  flow
ORDER BY
  year,
  value_eur DESC
LIMIT 10000
title: Largest changes by product group — exports 2022–2023

main.label: Natural or cultured pearls, precious or semi-precious stones, precious metals, metals clad with precious metal, and articles thereof; imitation jewellery; coin

insight: The HS2 product chapters with the largest decline in Luxembourg's exports from 2022 to 2023 were Iron and steel, which fell by 514.9 million euros, and Plastics and articles thereof, which decreased by 292.1 million euros.
The total export value of Iron and steel dropped from 1.90 billion euros in 2022 to 1.39 billion euros in 2023, showing a 27.1% decline.
Aluminium and articles thereof also saw a notable decrease of 165.8 million euros, down 23.9% from 694.7 million euros in 2022 to 528.9 million euros in 2023.
In contrast, exports of Vehicles and parts increased by 203.0 million euros, or 15.4%, during the same period.
These values are nominal and not adjusted for price changes, and 2.1% of the export value is confidential and not detailed in the data.
